requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve the historical coding snapshot with its original release and create a new versioned delta
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Historical coding remains bound to its original release while a new coding snapshot and delta are created.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: separate mapping-release changes from changes caused by new case evidence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Change reasons distinguish release/mapping evolution from new event or investigation facts.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: reject successful component replacement as automatic confirmed root cause
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Component replacement and post-service resolution remain observations unless causality is independently supported.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: silently rewrite historical coding to the newest release
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Prior snapshots remain auditable and are never silently normalized in place.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: convert component replacement or problem resolution into confirmed causality without evidence
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Coding preserves the causal boundary between component events, findings and confirmed conclusions.
